name: xAI Colossus 2 (Southaven turbine yard)
capacity_source: Reported 59 on-site gas turbines totalling up to 495 MW, operating unpermitted from late 2025; Mississippi permit for 41 permanent turbines granted Mar 2026 (SELC, Earthjustice, Mississippi Free Press). Epoch AI lists Colossus 2 at 946 MW. MDEQ PSD permit (Mar 2026): permanent plant 41 turbines = 1,240 MW with SCR, 423.4 t NOx/yr allowable
notes: On-site combustion site used for the NO2-flux generation estimate. No hall polygons yet. Southaven Combined Cycle plant (SCR, ~22 kg/h NOx, CAMPD) is 0.5 km away and flat.
nox_ef_note: Temporary fleet reported as Solar Titan/PGM-class units with DLE (SoLoNOx ~15 ppm -> ~0.25 kg/MWh) up to water-injected aeroderivatives (~42 ppm -> ~0.75); the permanent 41-turbine plant (16x Titan 350 35 MW, 17x PGM-130 16.5 MW, 8x ProEnergy 6000PE 50 MW = 1,240 MW) is permitted at 423.4 t NOx/yr with SCR (2 ppm), i.e. ~0.035 kg/MWh: once it replaces the temporary units, NO2 can no longer resolve load here (MDEQ PSD permit, 2875 Stanton Road, issued 2026-03-11). Emission factor widened to 0.5-1.5 kg/MWh: the NOx rate is calibrated on tall-stack coal plants, and gas-turbine exhaust has a much higher NO2 fraction, so the coal-calibrated NOx likely overstates turbine NOx by up to 2x; relative month-to-month changes are robust, absolute MW is uncertain by 2-3x
